title: Strict reduction tensor comparison existence
statement: For every coefficient reduction record R, there exists an isomorphism R.integralClosed.tensor⋙R.reduction ≅ (R.reduction.prod R.reduction)⋙R.systemClosed.tensor. No representative normalization is asserted.

proof.text: Construct the ordinary total tensor pullback on simultaneous flat-term K-flat complexes and descend it through resolving representative full faithfulness.
